{{Quote|My parents flew all the way from Coruscant for a wedding that never happened. You loathsome cad! I wish I'd never met you!|Prudy|<ref name="Best" />}}
At least two individuals were the '''parents''' of the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Prudy]] lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Best" /> In [[3644 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|2}} The conversation "Best Intentions" occurs shortly after "[[Archiban Frodrick Kimble|Doc]]" joins the party in the start of Act II, and as [[Prudy]] has not spoken with Doc for two years, their [[Marriage/Legends|wedding]] must have occurred in [[3644 BBY]].</ref> Prudy became engaged to a fellow [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] named [[Archiban Frodrick Kimble|Archiban Kimble]], on the planet [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], and Prudy arranged for her [[Parent/Legends|parents]] to travel from Coruscant in order to attend her [[Marriage/Legends|wedding]] with Kimble. However, their trip was in vain, as Kimble broke off his engagement to Prudy on the [[Standard day/Legends|day]] of their wedding. Prudy was still furious with Kimble for making her parents pay for the trip when they spoke<ref name="Best" /> [[3642 BBY|two]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later.<ref name="Time" />

==Behind the scenes==
Prudy's parents were mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]], where they are mentioned by their daughter in the conversation "Best Intentions" with the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class companion Kimble.<ref name="Best" />
